blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A vlogger‘s driver’s license has been placed under a 90-day preventive suspension by the Land Transportation Office (LTO) over alleged road safety violations in Palawan, including riding a motorcycle without wearing a helmet. The LTO, led by Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao, also issued a show-cause order (SCO) requiring the vlogger to explain his alleged violations. According to the LTO Mimaropa (Mindoro Occidental, Mindoro Oriental, Marinduque, Romblon, and Palawan), photos and videos circulating on social media showed the unnamed vlogger riding a motorcycle on a public road without a standard protective helmet.
